fact.subject: NVIDIA
fact.object: Vera Rubin 机架与开放基础设施规范

evidence.quote: NVIDIA joined industry leaders in contributing to the third-generation MGX AI data center reference design through OCP’s Open DC Initiative.

For NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI factories, the updated MGX 1.2 specification extends the open architecture for AI factories with rack-scale blind-mate liquid cooling, interoperable rack-scale interconnect infrastructure and a liquid-cooled 5,000A busbar designed for higher-power AI systems. It also adds native 19-inch equipment support and higher-density rack designs.

title: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide
displayTitle: NVIDIA 向 OCP 开放 Vera Rubin 机架规范
entities: Vera Rubin 机架与开放基础设施规范
summary: NVIDIA 在 OCP 峰会公布 Vera Rubin 相关机架与算力托盘设计贡献，MGX 1.2 纳入盲插液冷、机架互连及高电流母排等开放接口。
investorNote: 机架接口标准化会影响整机厂和散热、供电供应链的协作方式，但开放规范本身不等于量产交付。
narrative: NVIDIA 把 Vera Rubin 相关机架和计算托盘设计贡献给 OCP，并更新 MGX 1.2 的液冷、互连和供电接口。关键变化在于把 AI 工厂的约束推到机架级标准：整机厂可围绕共同接口开发，散热和电力部件的兼容性也更可比较；实际交付能力仍需看供应商验证。

eventRelation.reason: 原文证实为本窗口内独立的新动作，历史目录未见相同发生
